specs.title: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: Precondition: create a customer account
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: Precondition: log in the new customer with an empty basket
1. Open the product list
2. Click Add to Basket on the product
3. Open the basket
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: Precondition: put product A and product B into the basket
Precondition: log in the customer
1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button in the row of product A
3. Click the minus button in the row of product A
4. Click the minus button in the row of product A again
5. Click the trash button in the row of product A
Precondition: log in the new customer with an empty basket
1. Add the product to the basket from the product list
2. Click the plus button until the quantity is at the limit
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Click Add to Basket on the product in the product list

steps.title: Precondition: put the product with quantity 1 into the basket
Precondition: add 5.00 to the wallet with the saved card
Precondition: log in the customer
1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and click Continue
2. Select Standard Delivery and click Continue
3. Read the button Pay and check that it is disabled
4. Open the order history
5. Open the digital wallet
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address, select Standard Delivery and click Continue
7. Click the button Pay
8. Click Place your order and pay
9. Open the digital wallet
10. Open the order history
